summary: The figure shows the proportion of the population using safely-managed drinking-water services, sanitation services, and hand-washing facilities with soap and water across WHO regions and globally in 2020. The European Region has the highest proportion of safely-managed drinking-water services (92%) and sanitation services (70%). The Eastern Mediterranean Region has a high proportion of hand-washing facilities (81%). The African Region has the lowest proportions across all three services. Globally, about 74% have safely-managed drinking-water, 54% have sanitation services, and 71% have hand-washing facilities.
